notes.title: MacOS Official support
notes.content: Provides native build for MacOS (Apple Silicon) and officially supports it.

notes.title: Update 1.0.21 : Official PlayStation Controller Support
notes.content:
You can use the PlayStation controller for all game functions.
You can adjust the graphic quality in the settings menu.

notes.title: Steam Deck optimization, support native SteamOS
notes.content: Now you can enjoy games comfortably on the Steam Deck with the version created for native SteamOS.

notes.title: Update 1.0.20: Official Xbox Controller Support.
notes.content:
You can now use Xbox controllers for all features of the game.
(PS4 controllers will be supported in the 1.0.21 update, which is scheduled to be released within a week.)

notes.title: 1.0.19 Bug Fix
notes.content: Corrected the issue where more enemies than planned appear intermittently during extended gameplay.

notes.title: 1.0.17 Update (Balance Adjustment)
notes.content:
The price of costumes has been reduced.
The overall performance of costumes has improved.

notes.title: 1.0.16 hotfix
notes.content: Fixing the issue where the game starts in Korean in a Japanese language environment upon game launch.
